items.title: Inner work
items.body: Inner and outer reality as reflections of each other. Long, and the only piece here that names its own failure mode.

items.title: The essence
items.body: Absolute truth as a coin whose other side is disgust. On being “mocked and ridiculed and mercilessly reduced to void” by the same essence that later completes you.

items.title: Complexes and addiction
items.body: A subpersonality relaying information to the ego, and the urgency it manufactures being “literally chemically addicting.” Ends at “an addiction encouraged by an identity.”

items.title: Symbol and archetype
items.body: The Athena statue: Medusa as chaos consuming you until you are frozen to stone, Athena as integration, Nike as what comes from taming chaos.
items.annotation: Annotation — “I made up the following and do not know Greek mythology, but this is what I want to see”

items.title: Time and synchronicity
items.body: A two-dimensional bug crossing sheets of paper it cannot perceive as separate, while a three-dimensional observer sees the whole stack at once.

items.title: Power and attention
items.body: A talk on AI and the totalitarian state, and an academic paper on Appiah and cultural imperialism.

items.title: Early work
items.body: A time-travel plot written in the Notes app. Juvenilia, kept because it is where the arc starts.
items.annotation: Framing — “A way for my brain to express its chaos, aka art”
